beats.notes: Complete arc with a genuine SEL lesson (Noah rushes off alone and fails; Emma's careful, together approach wins); the parallel above-water parent search interleaved with the underwater quest adds real tension. Minor: the P1 beat calls it an old stone bridge though the setting is the covered wooden Thurbruecke.

scene.notes: Exceptional Art-Director briefs: precise positions and expressions, full identity + clothing anchors on every page, strong framing variety (wide establishing, close-up, medium, a bridge/river composite, a back-view reunion), and copy-space + calm-zone + emptyScenePrompt throughout. Briefs correctly specify a covered wooden bridge; the render drift to a stone arch was an image-model failure, not a brief one.

storyText.notes: Warm, vivid, age-appropriate prose that reads aloud well; Swiss orthography is clean (ss throughout, tight guillemets, the Swiss word Natel for the phone). One grammar slip: am ihr vorbei should be an ihr vorbei.

visualBible.notes: Very complete: all five characters with full physical traits + hex colours, a secondary character, measured artifacts (chest 40cm, marble-size pearls, sea-glass spacing), reference images generated. Consistency slips: Noah's mermaid top is a rash-guard in CLO003 but a shell top in costumes and every scene brief; the landmark query points at the Andelfingen railway (Eisenbahn) bridge, not the covered wooden road bridge the descriptions actually depict.
